# Pull requests whose work reached main by a route the merge-topology check cannot follow.
#
# The check verifies that a merged pull request's head commit is reachable from main. That fails
# for a branch which was force-pushed after its pull request merged: GitHub then records the
# rebased tip, which main has never seen, even though the original commits did land.
#
# The check cannot tell that case apart from genuinely lost work, so each one is recorded here by
# hand. An entry states why the work is present despite the commit not being reachable. If a
# listed pull request later becomes reachable on its own, the check says so and the line should be
# deleted.
#
# Format: <pull request number> <reason>

72 Force-pushed during a rebase after merging; original commit dbd1668 landed via the #77 recovery merge.
73 Force-pushed during a rebase after merging; original commit 44bd865 landed via the #77 recovery merge.
79 Force-pushed after merging; original commits 44b948b and 4278b3e remain present on main.
